observables.name: BlockFetch.Client.CompletedBlockFetch
observables.unit: full hash; serialized bytes; occurrence time
observables.boundary: Complete successful body receive and decode before ledger delivery
observables.native_meaning: Raw arrival, failed decode and downstream span end are not completion

observables.name: BlockFetch.Client.SendFetchRequest
observables.unit: actual range block count; endpoints; request/peer identity
observables.boundary: Start of the actual source connection write for the request
observables.native_meaning: API admission/enqueue and physical NIC departure are different boundaries

observables.name: BlockFetch.Server.SendBlock
observables.boundary: Per-block source body-send-call start, with eventual call result
observables.native_meaning: Do not substitute end of the whole batch or peer receipt

observables.name: ChainDB.AddBlockEvent.AddedToCurrentChain
observables.boundary: Authoritative validated selected-chain extension; applied publication retains its own authority/time
observables.native_meaning: Shared commit-chunk publication is not each block independent validation duration

observables.name: ChainDB.AddBlockEvent.SwitchedToAFork
observables.unit: ancestor and old/new full points; branch/generation
observables.boundary: Successful preferred-branch installation/publication
observables.native_meaning: Candidate detection, preferred peer change and rollback start are not successful replacement

observables.name: ChainDB.LedgerEvent.Snapshot.TookSnapshot
observables.unit: successful local count; elapsed seconds; tip
observables.boundary: Successful local snapshot write after its promised artifact finalization
observables.native_meaning: Scheduling/no-op/retry/upload/prune spans do not count as completed local writes

observables.name: ChainSync.Client.DownloadedHeader
observables.boundary: Decoded-header ingress before downstream validation/admission
observables.native_meaning: Preserve duplicate notices and each peer; analysis selects first notice

observables.name: ChainSync.ServerHeader.Update
observables.boundary: Before actual header/rollback send, including immediate and post-AwaitReply paths
observables.native_meaning: Identify the transmitted point rather than the server tip; distinguish waited announcements from catch-up

observables.name: Forge.Loop.AdoptedBlock
observables.unit: absolute slot; full hash; serialized bytes
observables.boundary: Successful own-block adoption at its source authority
observables.native_meaning: Keep signing, publication notification and applied adoption distinct

observables.name: Forge.Loop.BlockContext
observables.unit: target block number; parent; generation; seconds
observables.boundary: Actual parent/context acquisition for the attempt, including re-resolution
observables.native_meaning: Do not backdate final context into an earlier reference stage

observables.name: Forge.Loop.ForgeTickedLedgerState
observables.boundary: Actual completed native state advance with documented correspondence
observables.native_meaning: Integrated or differently ordered work is not a fictitious post-decision reference interval

observables.name: Forge.Loop.ForgedBlock
observables.boundary: Successful signed construction completed before admission
observables.native_meaning: Retain signed candidates even when subsequent selection/adoption loses

observables.name: Forge.Loop.ForgingMempoolSnapshot
observables.boundary: Consistent transaction snapshot acquisition, distinct from selection/revalidation/retry
observables.native_meaning: Retain discarded/rebuilt attempts; the entire build interval is not snapshotting

observables.name: Forge.Loop.LedgerState
observables.boundary: Actual consistent ledger/build-view acquisition
observables.native_meaning: A nonleader path need not acquire a view simply to manufacture a phase

observables.name: Forge.Loop.LedgerView
observables.boundary: Actual native forecast/leadership-input preparation interval
observables.native_meaning: Record cache/precomputation at its real time, not synthetic work in the current slot

observables.name: Forge.Loop.NodeIsLeader
observables.boundary: Actual completed positive leader decision before later gates
observables.native_meaning: Retain attempt/pool/generation and actual decision completion

observables.name: Forge.Loop.NodeNotLeader
observables.boundary: Actual completed negative leader decision
observables.native_meaning: Checker panic, unavailable state or early refusal is not an ordinary nonleader decision

observables.name: Forge.Loop.StartLeadershipCheck
observables.boundary: Entry to every actual slot attempt, including later refusal/error
observables.native_meaning: Never substitute a future leader schedule for executed work

observables.name: LedgerMetrics
observables.unit: absolute slot; UTxO cardinality; selected-fragment density
observables.boundary: Same published state/generation for cardinality, density and slot
observables.native_meaning: Preserve selected-fragment window/fallback provenance and rollback/epoch semantics

observables.name: Mempool.AddedTx
observables.unit: post-mutation count and standalone transaction CBOR bytes
observables.boundary: Successful addition under mutation authority
observables.native_meaning: Retained overlay/capacity memory is a separate native byte measure; duplicates do not add occupancy

observables.name: Mempool.RejectedTx
observables.unit: validation verdict count; full transaction identity if known
observables.boundary: Actual mempool validation rejection
observables.native_meaning: Capacity, duplicate, transient, infrastructure and transport outcomes retain distinct causes

observables.name: Mempool.RemoveTxs
observables.boundary: Actual removal mutation caused by inclusion/conflicting ledger invalidation
observables.native_meaning: Expiry/capacity eviction remain separately classified native causes

observables.name: Resources
observables.unit: CPU seconds cumulative; RSS bytes; current OS threads
observables.boundary: Sample the actual node process at 1000 ms plus or minus 10 percent; retain actual measurement time/process generation
observables.native_meaning: Go heap/goroutines/threads-created are not RSS/current OS threads

observables.name: TxSubmission.TxInbound.Collected
observables.boundary: Actual group handed to admission before processing
observables.native_meaning: A transport reply and a retried admission attempt are not automatically a new input group

observables.name: TxSubmission.TxInbound.Processed
observables.boundary: Terminal completion/cancellation of the declared submitted group
observables.native_meaning: Common accepted counts newly added transactions only; duplicate/already-known transactions count among not-added/rejected. Preserve native nil returns separately; rejected equals submitted minus newly added.

derived.name: Live after major GC inside/outside snapshot windows (R)

derived.name: Processed / accepted / rejected totals

derived.name: Reject ratio

derived.name: CPU per processed transaction
derived.boundary: (14-10)/4 in the same window; whole-node index, not isolated validation CPU

derived.name: Mempool occupancy / rejection count
derived.unit: transaction counts and common CBOR bytes
derived.boundary: Use atomic post-mutation common CBOR byte snapshots; duplicates do not grow occupancy
derived.native_meaning: Use declared source authorities and populations; native-phase correspondence and runtime scope are explicit in the observable definitions

derived.name: Optional ledger size/density
derived.boundary: Rollback publishes a new generation; each count/density pair is same-state
derived.native_meaning: Use declared source authorities and populations; native-phase correspondence and runtime scope are explicit in the observable definitions
